Commentary.Commentary: Right then! England need 203 to win the T20I series. Seems to be a bridge too far. But then this is M.Chinnaswamy where anything is possible. The conditions are not totally against India, with the pitch playing a bit two-paced and the ball stopping on the batsmen a bit. How the bowlers handle the dew will be key. Stay tuned for the run chase.

England were very inconsistent tonight. Whether it was the short boundaries, or the dew, one can't say but surely they would not have planned to concede 118 in the last 9 overs. Of those, only two overs went below 10, with the lower value being 8. Tymal Mills and Ben Stokes were impressive, finishing with 1/32 each in their 4 overs while we saw the other side of Chris Jordan tonight, going for 56 in his 4 overs. Strangely, Plunkett bowled just 2 overs with Morgan preferring to bowl 6 overs out of Moeen Ali and Adil Rashid, yielding a total of 53 runs without any wicket.

It was not the best of starts for the hosts as they lost skipper Kohli pretty early and then Rahul after a few good hits. But then, Raina started to explode, followed by Dhoni, combined with combustion from Yuvraj who propelled the score beyond 200.

So India finish on a commanding total. This is the first time a team has crossed the 200-run mark in T20Is at this venue. Did not look like they will do so at the halfway mark but scintillating knocks from Raina and Dhoni made it possible.

RUN OUT! Full toss on middle and leg, Pandya clips it through mid-wicket. Stokes the man in the deep, rushes towards the ball and hurls a throw at the striker's end. Pandya who goes for the second always seemed to be in trouble. Buttler collects it and calmly whips the bails off. Pandya is short of his ground by a long way and the umpire rules him out. A single is added to the total! INDIA FINISH ON 202/6!
Yorker! Jordan bowls it nicely, HP does well to dig it out through mid-wicket for a couple. India cross the 200-run mark!
SIX! Jordan once again fails to find his mark and Pandya takes full advantage of it. Lofts it over long on. Roy present there jumps to the fullest, gets his hand to it but fails to hold onto it.

SUPERB STUFF FROM ROY IN THE FIELD! Full on middle and off, Pandya clears his front leg and chips it over the bowler's head. Roy from long on gets across to it and stops the ball but he himself crosses the ropes. The umpires have a check upstairs and the replays show that Roy did extremely well to stop the ball before the fence. A couple is taken!
HARDIK PANDYA walks in next.

OUT! DHONI DEPARTS! Banged in short, Dhoni is surprised by that and takes his eyes off the ball as he goes for a pull. Misses it and gets it off the gloves straight to Rashid at short fine leg. Once again, Jordan gets better of Dhoni! That's the end of a superb knock, 56 off just 36 deliveries!
FOUR! Low full toss, Dhoni hits it powerfully straight down the ground. There's no long off in place but not sure even he would have stopped it. A boundary is signalled!
Wide! Wide outside off, it's too wide and Dhoni walks across and leaves it. A wide is signalled!
Final over then...India will aim for 200 at least...
FOUR! That spoils a good over for England! Pant shuffles and scoops the length delivery over backward square leg. Beats Plunkett in the deep and the ball crosses the ropes. 9 runs off the over!
Full outside off, Dhoni gets low and guides it through to third man for a single.
Angling into the pads, Pant looks to play it across the line but is hit on the pads and the ball goes towards covers. A leg bye taken!
Wide! Angling down leg, Pant shuffles and looks to scoop it but misses. A wide is signalled!
Back of a length slower one, Dhoni guides it behind square on the off side for a single.
Short delivery, pulled through backward square leg for a single.
RISHABH PANT walks in at number 6, replacing Yuvraj.

OUT! Slower one does the trick! Back of a hand slower one, Yuvraj who has backed a long way already, is beaten by the lack of pace on it. He tries to adjust but the ball goes off the leading edge straight into the gloves of Buttler. Timely wicket for England as Yuvraj was looking very threatening. That's end of a superb cameo from Yuvraj! Also, the end of a 57-run partnership!
TYMAL MILLS to bowl the 19th over.
Slowish one, Yuvraj lofts it over mid on for a single. Will retain the strike! 24 runs off the over! Superb one for the hosts!
SIX! Fuller one on the stumps, YS gets his front leg out and jabs it straight down the ground. It's so powerfully hit that it clears the ropes easily.
50-run stand comes up in just 25 balls!
FOUR! Very full on middle and leg, Singh picks his shot and flicks it over backward square leg for a boundary. Yuvraj is having a gala out there!
SIX! Back-to-back biggies! Fuller on the stumps, Yuvraj once again clears his front leg, this time hits it flatter but the result is the same. That's Yuvraj of the past!
SIX! Full on middle and leg, Yuvi clears his front leg and clobbers it over long on for a maximum. Finally he gets a boundary to his name!
MAIDEN T20I FIFTY for Mahendra Singh Dhoni! It has been a very crucial knock.
Angling into the stumps, Dhoni plays it with the angle through mid-wicket for a single. Brings up his half century with that!
CHRIS JORDAN comes back on.
Dhoni dances down and drives on the full to long off for a single.
FOUR! Fuller in the line of the stumps, Dhoni whips it over mid-wicket for a boundary. Dhoni once again uses his bottom hand to a superb extent!
Full outside off, pushed to mid off.
In the blockhole outside off, MSD looks to tap it but misses. Great bowling that!
Full and angling in, Dhoni whips it over mid-wicket. Roy in the deep cuts it out but fumbles. This allows Dhoni to take a couple.
FOUR! Full outside off, Stokes fails to hit his mark and Dhoni punishes him, drives it powerfully through mid off for a boundary.
On the pads, flicked on the leg side for a single.
Slower one on the shorter side of the length, guided through backward point for a single.
Wide! Down the leg side, YS looks to flick but misses. Buttler behind the stumps fumbles but luckily doesn't concede any byes!
Shortish again, placed to point for a single.
Shortish delivery, aimed at ribs, Yuvraj hops and looks to play it on the leg side, gets a leading edge towards short covers for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, guided to backward point for a single.
FOUR! Down the leg side, MSD glances it delicately. Gets it past short fine leg and the ball reaches to the fence. Dhoni is using the pace of the bowlers superbly. Second time in 3 deliveries!
TYMAL MILLS comes back on.
Angling down leg, played with the angle on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Back of a length delivery outside off, Dhoni guides it through the gap in point and gets a boundary for it. Good placement that!
Fullish delivery in the line of the stumps, driven back to the bowler.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Yuvi stays back and guides it through to third man for a single.
Angling into the pads, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
BEN STOKES comes back on.
On a length and outside off, Dhnoi looks to play it on the up but misses.
On the pads, flicked uppishly through square leg. Morgan from deep mid-wicket, runs to his right and dives to stop it good fielding there!
On the pads, MSD flicks it through mid-wicket. Charges for a couple and gets it!

OUT! RAINA DEPARTS! On a length and outside off, Raina who is on the charge looks to go big once again. Mistimes his loft high in the air. Morgan at extra cover gets a couple of steps back and grabs it with a reverse cup. Good breakthrough for England! That's the end of a 55-run partnership!
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
SIX! Sheer power that! Full on middle, Dhoni uses his bottom hand to a great extent. Whips it over long on for a maximum. 50-runs stand up between these two!
LIAM PLUNKETT comes back on.

WHAT WAS THAT! Four Byes! Tossed up outside off, spinning away, Raina gets down on one knee for a huge slog but gets beaten as the ball spins away sharply. Buttler also misses and Mills chases it from short third man but fails to stop it before the fence.
MSD dances down, Ali bowls it flatter on the pads, Dhoni drags it through fine leg. Mills at short fine leg dives full stretch and saves runs for his team. A single taken!
Shorter outside off, spinning away, cut to point for a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Spinning away, played with the spin to point for a single.
SIX! Another maximum! Tossed up delivery, Raina uses his feet, gets to the pitch of the ball and hits it straight down the ground for a biggie. Great shot that! India on a move!
Short outside off, spinning away, Raina cuts it but manages a bottom edge to point for a single. 15 runs off it!
4th T20I fifty for Raina!
SIX! Tossed up around off, Raina kneels down and slogs it over mid-wicket. Gets a maximum for it! Superb stuff from the Indian batsmen!
Shorter one outside off, punched off the back foot to mid on for a single.
SIX! That's a clean hit! Fuller on middle and off, Dhoni clears his front leg and heaves it over mid-wicket for a maximum!
Wide outside off, Suresh waits and lofts it over covers for a single.
DROPPED! Tossed up on middle and off, Raina hits it straight down the ground aerially. It's straight at Rashid but he fails to hold onto it. Could this prove costly?

Dhoni steps down the track, Ali darts it full and wide outside off, Dhoni manages to get power behind it and hits it straight down the ground. Raina has no time to get out of the firing line and the ball hits his back as he takes his eyes off the ball.
Shorter outside off, spinning away, SR stays in his crease and places it in the point region for a single.
Down the leg side, tickled round the corner. Gets it past Rashid at short fine leg. He chases and keeps it down to two.
Dhoni skips down the track, Ali drags his length back, spinning into the pads, Dhoni manages to drag it to square leg for a single. Clever bowling from Ali!
Shorter one wide outside off, Raina just places it in the point region for a single.
Flatter one, sliding into the pads, flicked behind square on the leg side for a single.
The ground is being roped up. This usually happens a lot in the Indian T20 League, around the half-way mark in each innings. This is to minimize the effect of dew.
Full and around off, pushed back to the bowler.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Landed outside off, Suresh plays the latest of late cuts, just past the keeper's gloves to third man. Substitute Liam Dawson gives it a good chase from short third man and slides near the boundary to keep the batsmen to a couple.
FOUR! Classical shot. Dropped short outside off, Raina backs away and places it behind point for a boundary!
Oh dear... replays show that on the ball which got rid of Rahul, STOKES HAD OVERSTEPPED! Rahul will consider himself unlucky.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Full on middle, pushed through long on for a single.
ADIL RASHID into the attack as well.

MISFIELD from Moeen. Full on middle, Raina pushes this towards long on. He sets off for a single but Dhoni does not run initially as he sees Moeen get to the ball. But the bowler is lazy to get across and the ball goes through. A single taken.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. Three dots in a row!
This one holds off the surface a bit, pitched around off, Suresh defends again.
Full and straight, defended back to the bowler.
Comes down the track, Moeen shortens the length, Dhoni adjusts well and tucks it towards short fine leg for a run.
Full and down the leg side, flicked through square leg for a single.
Dhoni takes off his helmet and dons a cap. Gets a different bat too.

THAT STAYED LOW! On a good length outside off, MS stays back to punch but the ball barely bounces, scooting off the surface, below the bat to the keeper. India will not mind that. Excellent over from Stokes, 3 runs and a wicket from it. His figures currently read 2-0-13-1.
Outside off, played straight to point.
Full on middle, pushed straight back past the bowler down to long on for a run.
Full and wide outside off, Dhoni reaches out to drive and gets an outside edge down to third man. A single taken.
Interesting. MAHENDRA SINGH DHONI walks in at number 4, replacing Rahul.

OUT! BOWLED! Stokes breaks the stand! Shows the values of bowling straight. Rahul was in that mood of attacking every ball and missed this one. He was playing beautifully up until now but for this ball, he just swung wildly. Stokes bowled an off cutter, pitching it on a good length outside off. Rahul was already through his shot even before the ball reached him. It went past the bat and hit the middle stump. The 61-run stand is broken in 37 balls.
On a good length around middle, Raina plays it down with the angle towards third man for a single.
BEN STOKES is back on.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot for a single. The stand is worth 60 from 35 balls. 11 from the over!
Fuller and wider outside off, LR slices it over cover and it lands just short of the substitute fielder Jonny Bairstow in the deep. A run taken.
Full and outside off, Lokesh drives it through the covers for a couple. The outfield is lightning quick. Moves to 21 from 16 balls.
The replacement ball has been taken but there is an issue with it. The umpires have a look and eventually decide to continue with the same.
SIX! COLOSSAL! Flighted outside off, Rahul jumps down the track and sends this miles up in the air and it is out of Chinnaswamy! New ball please!
50-run stand comes up in 31 balls! Raina has scored 31 of those.
Short and outside off, punched through point for a single.
Good start. Full and straight, pushed back to the bowler.
Here comes England's most economical bowler of the series - MOEEN ALI - 8-0-41-3 so far.
Another slower one, banged in on a length on middle, SR punches it wide of mid off for one. 14 from the over! INDIA END THE POWERPLAY ON 53/1.

SIX! Not sure who is going to reach this one though! A poor ball, down the leg side, on a length, Raina gets across and scoops it well over short fine leg. It lands onto the second tier! 50 UP FOR INDIA!
Comes down the track, Jordan rolls his fingers over the ball and bowls it fuller and wider outside off. Suresh cannot reach it.
Landed outside off, steered on the bounce to point.

TOP EDGE, BUT SIX! Jordan is smiling, Stokes is smiling, everyone is smiling. How did that happen? That is Chinnaswamy for you. A short ball around middle and leg. Raina goes for the hook but gets a top edge. The ball goes high in the air, Ben Stokes settles himself under it but the ball sails over him!
A slower ball down the leg side, Rahul gets down on a knee and looks to slog but misses. The ball goes off his pads to short fine leg and the batsmen take a leg bye.
Change of ends for Chris Jordan.
Full and down the leg side, Suresh has a swing but the ball goes off the inner half of the bat towards short fine leg.
WIDE. The batsman watches the bouncer go way above his head. The umpire has signalled a wide.
FOUR! Terrific placement! A short ball outside off, angling away from the batsman, Raina just places it through point and gets a boundary!
A good slower ball, Raina gives his indication to attack well in advance by jumping down the track and gets a slower bouncer. Tries to play the upper cut but is late and misses.
WIDE. Full and down the leg side, SR looks to flick but misses.
Landed outside off, tapped to the off side for a run.

IN THE AIR... SAFE! Miscommunication in the field now. A length ball on middle and leg, Suresh looks to go over the on side now but mistimes this one too. It goes off the toe end of the bat towards the region between mid on and mid-wicket. Chris Jordan is at mid on, Moeen Ali is at mid-wicket but both leave it to each other. In the end, the ball lands in between, albeit not sure whether either of them could have got to it anyways. A single taken.

A length ball outside off, Raina backs away to the leg side and looks to go big but mistimes it. The ball goes high in the air, does not have the distance but has enough to clear the man running back from cover. Two runs taken.
BEN STOKES comes on to bowl now.

A length ball outside leg, Suresh hops across and looks to tuck it away but the ball goes off his thighs towards short fine leg. A single taken, leg bye signalled. 12 from the over, just the momentum India needed.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads for a single.

Jumps down the track, Plunkett cramps him for room by bowling it short around leg stump, Raina takes his eyes off the ball and goes through with his pull shot and somehow gets it wide of short fine leg for a run.
This is around middle and off, now Lokesh quietly works it through mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Up and over! Back-to-back boundaries for Rahul! A length ball outside off, Rahul backs away slightly, not as much as Raina does and gets it cleanly over mid off for two boundaries in succession!

FOUR! Effortlessly done! Full and on middle and off, Rahul flicks it without any fuss over square leg. There is a man in place in the deep but he is at mid-wicket and the ball meets the fence! Even Plunkett is amazed at that shot.
LIAM PLUNKETT comes on to bowl now.
SIX! Lovely shot! Finally Raina gets one away. Landed outside off, slightly short of a full length, Raina backs away slightly, then reaches out and lofts it cleanly over cover-point for a maximum!
Landed outside off, run down to third man for a single.
A short ball outside off, Rahul looks to hook but is beaten by the extra bounce.
Full and outside off, Suresh pushes it towards cover-point and takes a quick single.

Whoa. Raina is getting desperate now. Without any warning, Raina comes down the track and has a wild heave, only to miss. The ball goes well wide of the leg stump. May be, India need to calm down a bit here. Indian skipper Virat Kohli said at the toss that the pitch might take turn later on. So may be, the batsmen need not go too hard on every ball. 150 could be defendable.
WIDE. Slants this down the leg side, Suresh initially looks to flick but then stops himself. The ball goes through to the keeper.
Full and outside off, Raina backs away to the leg side and looks to go over the top but mistimes it to mid off. Luckily for him, it does not carry to mid off.
The batsman has played it to the point region. One run added to the total.
Down the leg side, Lokesh misses his flick. The ball goes off his pads and the batsmen take a leg bye.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Full and outside off, driven straight to short extra cover.
Full and outside off, Raina drives this wide of mid off, eluding the dive from short cover and gets a single.
WIDE. Full and down the leg side, Raina misses his flick.
SURESH RAINA comes in at number 3, replacing his skipper.

OUT! Kohli is run out! Terrible mis-communication between the batsmen. On a good length outside off, Kohli misses his tuck and is hit on the pads. Jordan appeals for LBW but the umpire moves away. Meanwhile, Kohli sets off for the single and Rahul responds too. Jordan is alert to the situation and sets right across the pitch. Now, Rahul stops and Kohli stops too. There is no call of a yes or no and eventually, Kohli realizes he has to go back but is too late. Jordan is onto the ball and flicks it onto the stumps and the LED bails glow. Kohli stands over there in exasperation. He looks at Rahul and asks him to call. Rahul also retaliates, not sure as to what he said. But there should have been something said. Either a YES or a NO.
CHRIS JORDAN to bowl from the other end.

ALMOST DRAGS IT ON! Well, is the pitch two-paced? That is the third ball in this over which has not come on to the bat. Outside off, Kohli defends it with soft hands but still gets a thick inside edge. The ball almost goes onto the stumps. This time Rahul calls through for a run.
Outside off, finally Lokesh  finds the gap and earns a single behind point.
Full on middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.

Outside off, Rahul taps it towards the off side, sets off for a single but his skipper sends him back. Rightly so. Had they gone through for the single, one of them would have been walking back to the pavillion.
That ball has taken the inside edge of the batsman and thudded into his pads. One run added to the total.
WIDE. Strays down the leg side, Virat misses his flick. India off the mark.
Oops... a nervous start. Landed outside off, Kohli looks to tap and run but the ball hits the bottom of his bat and goes behind. Just eludes the stumps.

The national anthems have been done and dusted for the final time in this tour. VIRAT KOHLI and KL RAHUL are out in the middle to open the batting. TYMAL MILLS to begin the proceedings with the ball. Here we go...

India captain, Virat Kohli says he too would have batted first but isn't too disappointed with the toss. On the pitch, he reckons it's dry and will began to crack as the game progresses. Adds that first innings would be the best time to bat as the ball will hold on a bit in the second. Rishabh Pant makes his international debut, replacing Manish Pandey.

England captain, Eoin Morgan says that the pitch looks good and they will look to chase whatever is thrown at them. Adds that what happened last match has been left behind by them. Feels that his bowlers have been really good in the first two T20Is. One Liam replaces the other as Plunkett comes in for Dawson.
TOSS - Morgan calls it correctly for the third time in a row and opts to field first.

India on the other hand after losing two consecutive matches, they got back to the winning ways in Nagpur. However, it wasn't a great performance from the hosts. The Indian fans will hope that they would have saved the best for the last and come up with the goods in Bengaluru. So, with both teams going for the kill, we are in for a cracker of a match. Stay tuned for the toss!

Hello and a warm welcome to the third and final T20I between India and England at the M.Chinnaswamy Stadium. This also happens to be England's final match of this tour. The stage has been set perfectly for them to leave India on a positive note by winning the T20I series. After a dismal start to the tour, England have come back strongly and put on a great show in the coloured outfits. They would look to do the same tonight as well and clinch the series.
